Name: Rhoda
Summary: Rhoda was the servant girl who answered Peter's knock at Mary's house in Jerusalem on the night of his escape from prison. Recognising his voice, she ran back in joy without opening the gate, leaving Peter knocking outside.
KeyStory: Rhoda heard Peter's voice at the gate and ran to tell the praying church, forgetting to let him in.
LifeLesson: Joy can make us forget the door. Rhoda's church prayed for Peter's release and could hardly believe it came.
